notes:
Lead came via blog post 'RAG for small teams' signup. Early-stage startup building a searchable knowledge assistant for B2B onboarding docs. Interested in hosted API - want self-serve flow. Key snippets from call and notes below:

- Found us through SEO: 'redwood hosted inference' search -> signup + trial.
- Wants low-friction set up: 'we don't want infra ops, just reliable API + docs to plug into our vector DB'.
- Technical contact: CTO (Ava Delgado) - prefers email for follow-ups.
- POC ask: index ~60k short docs (avg 300 tokens), run semantic search + rerank, then chat layer on top.
- Latency targets: p95 generation + rerank <= 400ms for single-query flow; QPS initially ~5-15.
- Cost sensitivity: high — startup budget; asks for guidance on batching + caching to reduce per-token cost.
- Model preferences: open to Llama2/Redwood-curated open models; wants to avoid closed APIs for vendor-lock reasons.
- Vector DB: currently evaluating Pinecone vs Qdrant; primary question is integration pattern (push embeddings to vector DB vs on-demand). Wants example architecture for both.
- Embedding specifics: curious about dimensionality tradeoffs (1536 vs 768), and embedding model latency.
- Reranking questions: whether Redwood supports two-step retrieval (sparse->dense) + reranking on-hosted API, and cost/latency of reranker calls vs dense-only.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), audit logs, and retention controls. SOC2 compliance is a nice-to-have.
- Data residency: US-only preferred; not strict at this stage.
- Quote from CTO: 'If we can get a predictable cost per user and a simple integration with Pinecone, we can commit to the hosted plan.'
- Funnel notes: trial account created 2026-02-22; used free credits to run small embedding set; ran into index size and chunking questions.
- Asked for: 1) sample code for streaming embeddings ingestion + upserts to Pinecone, 2) recommended chunking strategy for 300-token docs, 3) suggested default reranker prompt/template.
- Short-term win: ship sample integration and a tiny demo showing rerank improvement on their dataset.
- Sales angle: emphasize self-serve onboarding, hosted single-tenant options later, and Optimize suggestions to reduce token spend.
- Reminders: attach benchmark doc comparing 1536 vs 768 dims (internal), include guidance on using prefix caching for repeated queries, show cost estimate for 10k queries/mo.

Internal follow-up items:
- Marcus to prep 15-min code walkthrough (embedding -> Pinecone upsert) and send to Ava by 2026-03-14.
- SE to draft rerank prompt templates + sample eval set instructions.
- Create short slide: 'Cost vs Latency tradeoffs for embeddings dims' and attach to Drive.
